capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the call.
steps.text: Hello, నేను marketplace నుంచి call చేస్తున్నాను. మీ order ORD-30009 గురించి మాట్లాడటానికి. మీరు account holder యేనా?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask about the order.
steps.text: Haan, నేనే మాట్లాడుతున్నాను. ఏమైంది నా order కి?

steps.purpose: Prompt the user for a verification factor before disclosing any specific order details.
steps.text: మీ delivery లో ఒక చిన్న issue ఉంది. కానీ details చెప్పే ముందు, మీ identity verify చేయాలి. మీ registered pincode చెప్తారా?

steps.purpose: Provide the pincode for verification.
steps.text: Pincode ఆ? నా pincode 500081. మీరు నా washing machine గురించే గా call చేసింది?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Acknowledge the successful identity verification and ask the user to wait while checking the order status.
steps.text: అవునండీ, washing machine గురించే. Verify చేసినందుకు thanks. ఒక్క నిమిషం line లో ఉండండి, నేను exact status check చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the current status and dates of the order.
Return order details.
Check the courier scan history for exceptions.
Return shipment tracking details.
Inform the customer of the exact exception returned by the track_shipment tool.
steps.text: నేను check చేశాను. Courier scan లో 'address unreachable' అని ఉంది. అందుకే మీ order delay అయ్యింది.

steps.purpose: Express confusion about the unreachable status.
steps.text: Address unreachable ఏంటి? నేను ఇంట్లోనే ఉన్నాను. Courier వాడు నాకు call కూడా చేయలేదు.

steps.purpose: Reiterate the courier scan truth as required by business rules, without inventing reasons for the failed delivery attempt.
steps.text: నాకు అర్థం అయ్యింది, కానీ courier scan లో address దొరకలేదు అని update చేశారు.

steps.purpose: Ask for a guaranteed delivery date.
steps.text: అయితే నాకు రేపు పక్కా delivery ఇస్తారా?
steps.clean_text: అయితే నాకు రేపు పక్కా delivery ఇస్తారా?
steps.model_visible_text: అయితే నాకు రేపు పక్కా delivery ఎస్తారా?

steps.purpose: Refuse to promise a delivery date that the tools do not support, adhering to grounding rules.
steps.expected_behavior: Decline to guarantee a future delivery date since the tool did not return one.
steps.text: నేను specific గా రేపు వస్తుంది అని promise చేయలేను, ఎందుకంటే courier నుంచి కొత్త date ఇంకా రాలేదు. System లో ఉన్న status మాత్రమే నేను చెప్పగలను.
steps.planner_rationale: Refuse to promise a delivery date that the tools do not support, adhering to grounding rules.

steps.purpose: Ask the agent to call the plumber, making an out-of-scope request.
steps.text: మరి ఏం చేయాలి నేను? నాకు washing machine install చేయడానికి plumber కూడా ready గా ఉన్నాడు. మీరు ఆ plumber కి call చేసి చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Identify the request to call the plumber as out of scope, decline it plainly, and offer to raise a complaint as the promised window has elapsed.
steps.expected_behavior: State clearly that calling a third party is outside the supported workflow without hallucinating a policy, and propose the valid next step.
steps.text: నేను మీ plumber కి call చేయలేను, అది మా service కిందకి రాదు. కానీ మీ order పెట్టి 7 days అయ్యింది, promised time 5 days దాటిపోయింది కాబట్టి, నేను delivery complaint raise చేయగలను.
steps.planner_rationale: Identify the request to call the plumber as out of scope, decline it plainly, and offer to raise a complaint as the promised window has elapsed.

steps.purpose: Ask for an explanation of what raising a complaint means.
steps.text: Complaint raise చేస్తే ఏం అవుతుంది? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు, కాస్త clear గా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Explain the complaint process in simple terms for a customer with low digital literacy.
steps.text: Complaint raise చేస్తే, మేము official గా courier కి ఈ address issue solve చేసి item deliver చేయమని చెప్తాము. నేను complaint raise చేయనా?

steps.purpose: Agree to raise the complaint and ask if it needs to be written down.
steps.text: Haan, raise చేయండి. కానీ ఆ complaint id నేను paper మీద రాయాలా?

steps.purpose: Raise a complaint for the delayed delivery.
Return the generated complaint ID and resolution timeline.
Provide the complaint ID and resolution time from the tool output, and reassure the customer they don't need to write it down.
steps.text: నేను complaint raise చేశాను. మీ complaint ID CMP-9921. మీరు paper మీద రాయాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు, అది మీ account లో update అవుతుంది. ఈ problem 2 days లో resolve అవుతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the complaint ID and resolution time from the tool output, and reassure the customer they don't need to write it down.

steps.purpose: Ask if they need to call back after 2 days.
steps.text: సరే, 2 days తర్వాత నేను మళ్ళీ call చేయాలా?

steps.purpose: Conclude the call by clarifying the next steps without making unsupported guarantees.
steps.text: ఈ 2 days లో courier వాళ్ళు status update చేస్తారు. మీరు వెంటనే మళ్ళీ call చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు.
steps.planner_rationale: Conclude the call by clarifying the next steps without making unsupported guarantees.
